Dear Fabrikam Ltd,

We have processed a refund of 120 for the currency conversion loss incurred due to the incorrect invoice currency. Your contracted invoice currency has been corrected to CHF-I20U.

Please allow a few business days for the refund to reflect in your account.

Best regards,
Customer Support
